# Files and directories of the covered C tree that scripts/provenance-report.py leaves out,
# because the port deliberately has no counterpart. One path per line, from the top of the
# Graphviz 16.1.0 tree; a directory covers everything under it. Say why on the line above.

# Generated by bison and flex from grammar.y, scan.l and htmlparse.y, which the report reads
# instead (the port follows those, not the generated tables).
lib/cgraph/grammar.c
lib/cgraph/scan.c
lib/common/htmlparse.c

# The renderers of output formats the port does not write (README.md, "Output formats").
plugin/core/gvrender_core_fig.c
plugin/core/gvrender_core_map.c
plugin/core/gvrender_core_pic.c
plugin/core/gvrender_core_pov.c
plugin/core/gvrender_core_ps.c
plugin/core/gvrender_core_tk.c

# The interactive viewers' event handling (the xlib and gtk plugins), which the port has not.
lib/gvc/gvevent.c

# Back the command-line tools (gvpr, unflatten, gvmap, edgepaint), not a layout or a renderer.
lib/cgraph/ingraphs.c
lib/cgraph/unflatten.c
lib/sparse/DotIO.c
lib/sparse/clustering.c
lib/sparse/color_palette.c
lib/sparse/colorutil.c
lib/sparse/mq.c
